L2.features: violation count only (commitments are opaque hashes)

notes: Classifier is implemented with the standard library; no pip install was performed. sklearn, if present, is not used.
L0 exposes rule + kind; L1 exposes category + count; L2 exposes only opaque evidence commitments (the feature uses violation count only, because hashes do not generalize across samples).
Action utility is a proxy: L0 maps kind -> specific repair action; L1 maps category -> generic action (content cannot distinguish keyword vs pattern); L2 -> manual review.
This measures the certificate public-value channel only. Circuit public values still contain raw rule/kind (see docs/blockers/C1.md).
